topic.title: Review Tasks
topic.shortdesc: A review task is a shared review space where task owners and reviewers work together on content feedback.

body.p: In , review tasks are used to collect feedback on content. A task owner shares content with reviewers, who open the task in a browser-based editor to read, comment, and suggest changes.
Review tasks support a focused review workflow. Instead of sending files by email, authors can share a task link and keep all comments, suggestions, and discussions in one place.

section.title: Types of review tasks
section.p: supports two types of review tasks: Project Review Tasks and Independent Review Tasks.
Project Review Tasks are created from content in a project. They are part of the project workflow. Accepted changes can be integrated back into the project content.
Independent Review Tasks are not tied to a project. They can be created in the interface or from supported desktop tools. Any follow-up integration is handled outside the project workflow.

To create independent review tasks from desktop tools, install the Oxygen Content Fusion Connector add-on. It integrates Oxygen Content Fusion into Oxygen XML Editor and Oxygen XML Author. This allows users to create independent review tasks directly from those desktop tools and integrate proposed changes back into the original content source. For more information, see the Oxygen Content Fusion Connector Add-on Documentation.

section.title: Who can create and participate in review tasks
section.p: Project Review Tasks can be created only by Authors. Independent Review Tasks can be created by both Authors and Subject-Matter Experts.
Any user can participate in a review task as a Reviewer.
Within a review task, users participate through .

ul.li: Owner - Manages the task, shares access, and controls the review workflow.
Reviewer - Reviews the content, adds comments, suggests changes, and joins discussions.
